verdict.rationale: The Go SDK docs show a CheckWithContext call for checking availability of one or multiple domains and a GetTldListWithContext for enumerating TLDs, which loosely supports 'instant availability' and 'alternate TLD' checking at the API level, but there is no evidence about the actual consumer-facing search UI speed, suggestion quality, or any policy/behavior regarding not squatting on searched names. Missing for 10: evidence of search speed/UX, alternate-TLD suggestion behavior in the search tool, and any explicit anti-squatting policy or independent confirmation that searched names aren't registered by Namecheap.
